roadmap.title: Main game: story and collectibles
roadmap.description: Make manual saves and follow the collectible checklist while playing through all eight chapters. The four story objectives fall in order: basement power, sewer valves, Male Ward sprinklers, Female Ward key.

roadmap.title: Whistleblower DLC: story and collectibles
roadmap.description: Play the DLC in one run with the collectible checklists open; the fence switch comes before the gas valve.

roadmap.title: Insane runs
roadmap.description: With both routes known, replay the main game and then the DLC on Insane without dying.

achievements.description: Restore power to the Administrative Block
achievements.summary: Restore power to the Administrative Block.

steps.text: Leave the Security Room and take the stairs near the elevator down to the basement.
Turn on the pump in each of the two rooms around the main control.
Go through the door that was locked when you arrived and throw the breaker in the electrics room.
Go back to the main control and press the button to turn the power on.
steps.note: A guard patrols the basement, so watch your step.

steps.text: Turn the first valve, behind the green door on the right side of the area.
Cross the main chamber and follow the tunnels to the second valve opposite it, then turn it to unlock the achievement.
steps.note: Walker patrols the area around the tunnels.

achievements.description: Activate the sprinklers in the Male Ward
achievements.summary: Turn on the Male Ward sprinklers.

steps.text: From where the big man first chases you, go to the room on the far right of the large room. It connects through another room to a third one that holds the first pump valve. Turn it on.
Turn on the second pump in the left corner of that same large room.
Return to the corridor you came from and press the button in the room there to start the sprinklers.

achievements.description: Collect the key in the Female Ward
achievements.summary: Pick up the key in the Female Ward.

steps.text: Head up the stairs to the room with the tipped-over wheelchair, take the left staircase and pass through the serving hatch into the fuse room.
Take the three fuses from three separate rooms and bring each one back to the fuse room.
steps.note: The patient guarding one fuse turns hostile once you take it. Leave the room quickly.

steps.text: Place all three fuses and push the button so the key drops down the chute.
Go back downstairs, follow the laundry signs and take the key from the laundry hatch.

achievements.summary: Find 15 documents and finish 15 recordings in the main game.

guide.context: Everything must come from one playthrough: chapter select and starting a new game reset your counts. Make a manual save before each chapter (up to 50 saves) so you can go back if you miss something.

steps.text: Pick up documents and film recordings using the Pulitzer checklist as you play.
Reach 15 of each. If you miss none, the last of the 15 recordings is Let It Burn in the Male Ward.

achievements.summary: Finish the main game on any difficulty.

steps.text: Play through to the ending on any difficulty.

achievements.description: Collect all documents and complete all recordings
achievements.summary: Collect all 31 documents and complete all 31 recordings in the main game.

guide.context: Everything must come from one playthrough: chapter select and starting a new game reset your counts. Make a manual save before each chapter (up to 50 saves) so you can go back if you miss something.

collectibles.name: Document: The Whistleblower
collectibles.method: Picked up automatically in the opening car scene.

collectibles.name: Recording: Mount Massive Asylum
collectibles.method: Once inside the gate, aim the camera at the main building.

collectibles.name: Document: Patient Status Report For William Hope (Project Walrider)
collectibles.method: Squeeze through the corridor gap, then search the desk of the second office on your left.

collectibles.name: Recording: I'm Inside
collectibles.method: Film the officer's last words.

collectibles.name: Document: Warrant for Seizure
collectibles.method: Get up after the fall through the window. It sits on the security desk right ahead.

collectibles.name: Document: Patient Status Report For Chris Walker (Project Walrider)
collectibles.method: Go through the computer office into the storage room, then check the desk in the corner on your right.

collectibles.name: Recording: Broken Men And Dead Television
collectibles.method: Film the men watching the static screen.

collectibles.name: Recording: The Witness
collectibles.location: Bathroom left of the Security Room
collectibles.method: Push open the center stall and record the body.

collectibles.name: Document: Project Walrider Profitability Report
collectibles.method: Walk the corridor beyond the Security Room to the office. It is on the desk at the back.

collectibles.name: Recording: Big Guy
collectibles.method: After you use the Security Room computer and the lights go out, hide in the locker and film the big man.

collectibles.name: Document: MKULTRA CIA Hypnotic Suicide
collectibles.method: Pass the first wall gap in the basement and look at the desk to the right.

collectibles.name: Recording: Father Martin's Cell
collectibles.method: Film any part of the wall inside the cell.

collectibles.name: Recording: Necromantic
collectibles.method: After leaving the first prison section, climb through the wall and film the disturbing group beyond it.

collectibles.name: Document: Father Martin, Finger Painter
collectibles.method: Follow the blood trail up the stairs to an inmate studying bloody writing. Search the desk beside him on his left.

collectibles.name: Document: Purge Gate Maintenance Memo
collectibles.method: After climbing out of the window past the two men behind the gate, look in the office on the left with the broken window and check its desk.

collectibles.name: Recording: Total Security
collectibles.method: While walking the corridor to the shower keycard, look down and to the left and film the big man.

collectibles.name: Document: Dr. Wernicke Death Certificate
collectibles.method: From the shower area go right, then left into the room with a torture chair. Check the desk on your right. Take it before you leave the shower area for the next section.

collectibles.name: Document: Dr. Wernicke Obituary
collectibles.method: Take the side route toward the showers, leap to the upper ledge and climb. Search the nearest cell on the left.

collectibles.name: Recording: Walrider
collectibles.method: Fall through the floor hole, descend the stairs and record the blood-written message across the wall and lockers.

collectibles.name: Document: The Gospel Of Sand
collectibles.method: After entering the sewer, follow it round to the left. It lies on the left side by a broken ladder.

collectibles.name: Recording: The Doctor Is Dead
collectibles.method: After draining the water, passing the lower sewer and climbing the far ladder, walk the lit corridor and enter the room on the left. Film the inmate speaking in the corner.

collectibles.name: Document: Still Bleeding
collectibles.method: In the dark flooded stretch, drop off a catwalk beyond the corpse draped over the railing. Go ahead, climb onto the next walkway and follow it to the last room. The folder lies beside the body in the corner.

collectibles.name: Recording: A Feast For Flies
collectibles.location: Door window past the sewer gap
collectibles.method: After the blood-filled sewers, squeeze through the gap and ignore the stairs on the right. Keep going forward and film the bodies packed behind the door window on the left.

collectibles.name: Recording: Organized Torture
collectibles.location: Dark room beside the restraint chair
collectibles.method: Shove the unit away and crawl the vent to the room with the strapped-down inmate. Exit, turn left into the next dark room and record the wall scrawl with night vision on.

collectibles.name: Document: Project Walrider Cost Report
collectibles.method: Enter the hospital ward and walk to its back end. Search the final cubicle on the right.

collectibles.name: Recording: Dr. Rick Trager
collectibles.method: Once out of the wheelchair, leave and find the man tied to a bed. Hide beneath a bed close by and record Trager murdering him. Registration can be slow, so stay hidden and keep recording.

collectibles.name: Document: Request for Reassignment
collectibles.method: While searching for the elevator key, move the unit aside and take the vent at the far end of the following corridor. Land, walk into the bathroom ahead and search its right stall.

collectibles.name: Recording: Death Of Trager
collectibles.method: After you kill Trager at the elevator, film his body.

collectibles.name: Document: Persecutorial Delusions
collectibles.method: Speak with Father Martin, then go along the dark corridor to your left and turn at the first right. The locker room is behind the end door; the folder rests by the bench at the back.

collectibles.name: Recording: Let It Burn
collectibles.method: Climb through the window into the cafeteria and film the inmate explaining why he set it on fire.

collectibles.name: Document: Psychopathological Proximity Stress Disorder Pamphlet
collectibles.method: Exit the cafeteria and, before the gap ahead, follow the right-hand corridor. Search the corner desk of the last room.

collectibles.name: Recording: Fingers
collectibles.method: After turning on the sprinklers and crossing the cafeteria again, an inmate knocks you down at the kitchen. Look around the counter on your left for a side room and film the bowl of fingers.

collectibles.name: Document: MKULTRA Program Excerpt
collectibles.method: Before leaving through the exit, enter the office on the right and check the desk at the far end.

collectibles.name: Document: Our Own Personal Cavalry
collectibles.method: Step outside, pass the fountain and climb the stairs to the wall writing. The folder is lying on the ground.

collectibles.name: Recording: The Thing In The Dark
collectibles.method: Unlock the door with the key, then go down the corridor with the camera raised and night vision on. Record the ghost that shows itself once the second door is open.

collectibles.name: Recording: Don't Drink The Water
collectibles.method: Shake off the big man, crawl through the tunnel and record the blood-and-corpse fountain at its exit.

collectibles.name: Recording: The Sound In The Machine
collectibles.method: After climbing into the Female Ward, squeeze through a gap and hop through a window. Film the noisy machine there.

collectibles.name: Document: Walrider And Nightmares
collectibles.method: Exit through the lit room, turn right in the corridor and follow it to the end. Look beneath the broken stairs.

collectibles.name: Recording: No Safe Place
collectibles.method: Where the stairs and a wheelchair stand together, record the corpse underneath the elevator lift.

collectibles.name: Document: Project Paperclip Excerpt
collectibles.method: Descend the stairs beside the lift into the dark room. A desk in its center holds the folder.

collectibles.name: Document: You Promised Me A Rose Garden
collectibles.method: Fall through the floor, climb back up and enter the next room by its door. The folder is on the bed in the back corner.

collectibles.name: Recording: Lies
collectibles.method: Trail the Walrider down the corridor, step into the candlelit room to the right and record the blood writing there.

collectibles.name: Document: Billy's Dreams
collectibles.method: Flee the big man into the corridor-left room's vent. Inside, take the right-hand branch and drop into the office. Search its desk.
collectibles.group: Chapter 7 — Back in the Administration Block

collectibles.name: Document: The Spirit Breach
collectibles.method: Push the corpse out of the vent and drop to the main corridor. Enter the library on the left and search the computer desk.
collectibles.group: Chapter 7 — Back in the Administration Block

collectibles.name: Recording: The Wernicke Exit Interview
collectibles.method: In the theatre, film the screen while the movie plays. Keep filming until the recording notification appears; it takes a while.
collectibles.group: Chapter 7 — Back in the Administration Block

collectibles.name: Document: Necrotizing Fasciitis
collectibles.location: Lit room at the end of the dark corridor
collectibles.method: Leave the theatre and walk the dark corridor, ignoring the upstairs route. Continue ahead to the lit room at the end, where the folder rests on stacked boxes.
collectibles.group: Chapter 7 — Back in the Administration Block

collectibles.name: Recording: Static Prayer
collectibles.method: After the door is unlocked and you go upstairs, pass the kitchen and the large hall with an inmate at the window. In the corridor beyond, enter the recreation room on the right and film the inmate praying before the static TV.
collectibles.group: Chapter 7 — Back in the Administration Block

collectibles.name: Document: The Gospel Of Judas
collectibles.method: Past the wall gap lies a corridor of praying inmates. Search the desk inside room B329.
collectibles.group: Chapter 7 — Back in the Administration Block

collectibles.name: Recording: The Passion Of Father Martin
collectibles.method: Keep recording Father Martin's burning in the church to the very end of the scene.
collectibles.group: Chapter 7 — Back in the Administration Block

collectibles.name: Recording: Under The Mountain
collectibles.method: On entering the underground lab, film the desk in the first room.

collectibles.name: Document: The Pride Of Wisdom
collectibles.method: It lies behind the same front desk you just filmed.

collectibles.name: Document: Variant Postmortem
collectibles.method: Down the next corridor, walk into the second lab on the left and search the table.

collectibles.name: Recording: Morphogenic Formula
collectibles.method: Go farther along the corridor to the green-lit door across from the truck window. Inside, record the whiteboard.

collectibles.name: Recording: Death Of The Soldier
collectibles.method: Registers automatically after the cutscene where the Walrider kills the big man.

collectibles.name: Document: Gods And Monsters
collectibles.method: Survive the ghost chase and pass the upstairs decontamination room. In the room after it, search the right-hand desk by the guard's body, ahead of the huge wall.

collectibles.name: Recording: Wernicke's Machine
collectibles.method: Go through the tunnel into the machine-filled lab and record the enormous sphere ahead.

collectibles.name: Document: Morphogenic Engine Chamber Precautions
collectibles.method: Check the computer bank directly under the giant sphere.

collectibles.name: Recording: Billy Hope
collectibles.method: Right next to that document, film the man inside the glass pod on your left.

collectibles.name: Recording: Life Support
collectibles.method: Follow the signs to the Life Support Fluid Reservoir and film the large tanks as you enter.

collectibles.name: Document: The Modern Prometheus
collectibles.method: From the same area, go up the stairs and check the desk in the control room.

collectibles.name: Document: Permission To Proceed
collectibles.method: Finish at the Sublab Generator, then flee the Walrider through the decontamination room. Climb the stairs and search the desk on the left inside.

collectibles.name: Recording: Death Of Hope
collectibles.method: Watch the Walrider cutscene, go back to the main room and turn off the Life Pod failsafe. Record the pod filled with blood.

achievements.description: Finish the game in Insane mode
achievements.summary: Finish the main game on Insane difficulty.

guide.context: Insane has no checkpoints and no manual saves, so dying sends you back to the start. You carry only 2 batteries, and bosses kill in one hit.

steps.text: Start a new game on Insane difficulty.
Reach the ending without dying.
steps.note: Practice on Nightmare first, which has the same 2-battery limit. Raise the brightness to maximum and use night vision only when needed to save battery.

achievements.summary: Turn off the gas in the Whistleblower DLC.

steps.text: During the chase by the electric-saw patient, enter the large room with doors on the left and right.
Take the right door, follow the hallway and turn left.
At the next hallway on your right, follow it to the end and climb over the wall. The patient cannot follow you over it.
Continue down the hallway to the gas valve room and turn off the gas.

achievements.summary: Turn off the electricity in the Whistleblower DLC.

steps.text: Reach the electric fence outside.
Go down into the small underground hallway and flip the switch.
steps.note: The achievement unlocks the first time you flip it. If a patient turns the power back on later, flip the switch again to get past the fence.

achievements.summary: Finish the Whistleblower DLC on any difficulty.

steps.text: Play the Whistleblower DLC through to its ending on any difficulty.

achievements.description: Finish the DLC in Insane mode
achievements.summary: Finish the Whistleblower DLC on Insane difficulty.

guide.context: Insane has no checkpoints, and dying restarts the whole DLC. Batteries are limited and enemies are tougher.

steps.text: Start the Whistleblower DLC on Insane difficulty.
Reach the ending without dying.

achievements.summary: Collect all 13 documents in the Whistleblower DLC.

guide.context: Everything must come from one playthrough: chapter select and starting a new game reset your counts. Make a manual save before each chapter (up to 50 saves) so you can go back if you miss something.

collectibles.name: Document: Resignation of Waylon Park
collectibles.method: Where doctors run past to the exit, turn right instead of going forward into the side room covered in bodies. Turn right and go through the door. The document is on the ground.

collectibles.name: Document: Gender Selection in Mount Massive Contractors
collectibles.method: Take the key off the corpse, then enter the operating room with ceiling-hung monitors. The folder sits on a cart between two computers.

collectibles.name: Document: God and Family
collectibles.method: Escape the fire through the brick wall, turn right through the open doorway and search behind the altar.

collectibles.name: Document: Lesser Known Ecological Aspects of Humanity
collectibles.method: Go through the plastic by the locked airlock door, jump through the broken window and enter the dark hall across from it. Turn on the camera light; the document is deep in the darkness.

collectibles.name: Document: Patient Status Report for Frank Manera (Project Walrider)
collectibles.method: Go through the double metal doors into the small lab. The document is in the corner of the desk on the right, next to the chrome machines.

collectibles.name: Document: The Walrider Delusion
collectibles.method: Beyond the basketball court, climb the ladder on the opposite side. Walk around the booth at the top and clamber over the clutter into it.

collectibles.name: Document: Miscarried Profits
collectibles.method: Past the patient smearing blood messages behind the grate, drop into the floor hole, go through the door and check the desk on the right in the computer room.

collectibles.name: Document: The Groom
collectibles.method: Jump out of the window and turn to face the double doors. Enter by the window to their left; the folder is in the left corner.

collectibles.name: Document: Kill Us
collectibles.method: After the stairs to the sparking electric fence, skip the fence and walk into the dark house ahead. The document lies near a closed double door at the back.

collectibles.name: Document: Patient Dennis
collectibles.location: Dark area beside the red cart
collectibles.method: Past the hanging corpse in the attic, a red tool cart blocks a doorway. Skip it and go left into the darkness for the document.

collectibles.name: Document: Patient Status Report of Eddie Gluskin (Project Walrider)
collectibles.method: Sprint and leap through the open window into the courtyard with the stone fountain. The folder lies on the ground right of the pond.

collectibles.name: Document: Beyond Hope
collectibles.method: In the hallway where you hear gunfire, enter the office on the left and take the document from the inner desk.

collectibles.name: Document: Three Blind Dreamers
collectibles.method: Cross the room with the wall-mounted TV, exit by the door and take the open doorway ahead on the right. A table in the dark room has the folder.

achievements.summary: Complete all 18 recordings in the Whistleblower DLC.

guide.context: Everything must come from one playthrough: chapter select and starting a new game reset your counts. Make a manual save before each chapter (up to 50 saves) so you can go back if you miss something.

collectibles.name: Recording: If I Die
collectibles.method: Added automatically when you pick up the camcorder at the start.

collectibles.name: Recording: A Radio in the Prison
collectibles.method: After climbing through the first vent, film the two guards talking.

collectibles.name: Recording: The Doctors Are Sick
collectibles.method: When a doctor is locked in a glass chamber, press the glowing button, keep the camera up and film the killer patient until it ends.

collectibles.name: Recording: In the Cannibal's Kitchen
collectibles.method: Record the patient ripping a corpse apart on the other side of the cafeteria glass.

collectibles.name: Recording: Varying Effects
collectibles.method: At the spinning red light in the hallway, go left through an open door, then left again to the bathroom stalls. Film what is in the middle closed stall.

collectibles.name: Recording: Satisfaction
collectibles.method: Go down the stairs outside and turn right to a fence gate. Go through, look up at the building on your right and film the left window.

collectibles.name: Recording: This Is What the Game Is
collectibles.method: Reach the stone steps with a landing and go left through the open fence. Follow the alley, then turn right to the fenced gap and record the basketball player.

collectibles.name: Recording: Down, Down, Down
collectibles.location: Grated door in the dark hall
collectibles.method: Once Walker is behind you, continue along the dark hall to the grate and record the patient smearing blood messages beyond it.

collectibles.name: Recording: Burning Lights
collectibles.method: After you cut the power by the fence, a patient turns it back on. Keep the camera ready and film the power grid above the fence.

collectibles.name: Recording: An Easy Way Out
collectibles.method: Climb out of the pond by the ladder and find the gap in the door on your right. Crawl through with the camera on the lit door; a corpse falls in front of it, so record that.

collectibles.name: Recording: Wise Man
collectibles.method: In the vocational block attic, film the hanging corpse in your path.

collectibles.name: Recording: What Fresh Hell
collectibles.method: You pass this in the sewing-machine area; it cannot be missed. Film the doctor delivering a baby.

collectibles.name: Recording: An Unwilling Bride
collectibles.method: After escaping the torture scene on the saw-blade table, turn back and film the saw blade.

collectibles.name: Recording: Blue Beard's Wives
collectibles.method: Climb through the vent into the gymnasium and film the ceiling full of dead bodies.

collectibles.name: Recording: A Widower
collectibles.method: After you survive the next torture scene and the man dies, film his body.

collectibles.name: Recording: A Burning Church
collectibles.method: As soon as the chapter loads, film the burning church in the distance from the window.

collectibles.name: Recording: Serve and Protect
collectibles.method: Walk the hallway to the barred, locked door in front of a lit room. Record the soldiers gathered around the body at its center.

collectibles.name: Recording: Jeremy Blaire
collectibles.method: By the exit doorway in the lobby, film the wounded man in the passageway before you walk through.
